title: TUR problem report receiver answers
description: The bodies the receiver (server/report-receiver) answers with, all application/json. POST /v1/reports with a bundle as the body (Content-Type application/vnd.tur.diag-bundle+zstd) answers 202 with a receipt. GET /v1/reports/<status_token> answers 200 with a state and nothing else. Every refusal answers with an error and a stable TUR-DIAG-RECEIVER code (docs/architecture/problem-reports.md). The Rust types in tur_diag::report and in the receiver are authoritative and tests compare them with this schema.

status_token.description: 256 random bits. The receiver keeps only its SHA-256.

status_url.description: The receiver's public address, /v1/reports/ and the token.

retention_days.description: How long the bundle is kept, encrypted.

state.description: received: stored, not yet filed. filed: a summary is in the tracker. fixed: a maintainer marked it fixed in a version.

message.description: A short sentence. Never quotes the upload.

detail_code.description: For a bundle that did not verify, the TUR-DIAG-BUNDLE code; null otherwise.
